objective: Evaluate temporal reconstruction and local calibration across independent acquisition days in human MCF-10A optoFGFR/ERK; separately audit compatibility of recorded stimulus protocols with FD designs.
grouping: All positions, cells, pulse schedules, overlapping windows and clock periods from one day stay in the same split. File count and cell count are not independent replicate counts.

secondary_domains.binary_5_7_min: 16 CSV files from 2021-04-07, one day; retain as ancillary protocol transfer, never split rep labels into independent days.
secondary_domains.binary_20_30_min: 20 CSV files from 2019-09-03, one day; multiple periods can be segments of one acquisition.
secondary_domains.interval: 15 CSV files; input prefixes audited. Freeze acquisition mapping and any predictive roles before response scoring.

data_contract.input: is_light_pulse marks a 100 ms flash within the current minute, not sustained illumination during that minute; confirm within-frame alignment from acquisition files before transition scoring.
data_contract.output: Use original nuclear ERK-KTR and contemporaneous image intensity, with structural validity flags and no response-amplitude exclusion. A future prediction cannot use future image intensity as a predictor.
data_contract.causality: Q3 centered and Q4 whole-track normalization are disallowed in prospective prediction. The CSV export uses Q3backw, which is backward-looking; do not mislabel that exported column as future-leaking. Recompute causal variants from source fields and verify correspondence.
data_contract.selection: Retain every structurally usable exported track, including is_preselected=False. Report the 400-track published subset as a sensitivity only. The exported 500 were already selected by duration/nuclear-area stability, so full-population representativeness remains unestablished.
data_contract.missingness: No interpolation, no zero-filling, no response clipping. Report unsupported windows, missing timestamps and conflicting input labels.
data_contract.statistical_unit: Day/acquisition for transport evidence; cells and overlapping windows retain dependence. Two held-out days do not support broad population or clinical claims.

local_jurisdictions.nesting: domain > acquisition day > clock protocol > field > cell > temporal segment; cross these with horizon, time since pulse, preceding input history and calibration support.
local_jurisdictions.predefinition: Define partitions with input/timing/structural metadata or training-only cutpoints. Do not select test jurisdictions by observed benefit.
local_jurisdictions.edges: Matched cell/time/support comparisons of baseline, unguarded calibration and guarded local policy; spatial geometric proximity is distinct from a measured biological connection.
local_jurisdictions.aggregation: Retain atomic residual identities; reconstruct parent sums and distributions without duplicate membership. Local harms, tails and coverage are primary; global RMSE/MAE are complementary.
local_jurisdictions.unresolvable: Keep NOT_ESTIMABLE and OUT_OF_SUPPORT with their support and reason; no zero-effect substitution.

next_execution_gates: Verify complete archive checksum remotely, canonical headers and full input consensus across tracks for each used CSV.
Reconcile timestamp trimming, experiment onset and pulse-to-image order; freeze alignment/sensitivity without inspecting prediction scores.
Fit domain-specific reference models on TRAIN only; E. coli coefficients and cuts are not biologically transferable by fiat.

Freeze horizons, history lengths, local cutpoints, early-fit/validation/late windows, purge intervals, support thresholds and policy choices in a numerical E9 evaluation protocol before evaluating TEST.
Run paired local comparisons on identical support, retaining adverse and unresolved jurisdictions; record all candidate choices.
Treat a pulse-block alphabet extension of FD identities as a separate mathematical obligation. Require both delivered arms and acquisition assumptions before calling any dataset direct FD validation.
compute: CPU-only sequential CSV/chunk processing; no full image segmentation for E9. A 4 GB peak-memory claim and runtime estimate require a pilot measurement; neither is asserted here.
